title: Catalog Fact
description: A single evidence-backed claim in the repository archaeology catalog. Every `confirmed` fact must carry provenance (file + detection_method). Line numbers are HINTS, not identity — commit + file + symbol are the durable anchors.

fact.description: The claim, stated as a falsifiable sentence.

file.description: Repo-relative path the evidence lives in. Required when confidence=confirmed.

symbol.description: Durable anchor: function/class/route/table name. Preferred over line numbers.

commit.description: Commit the fact was verified against (short SHA).

detection_method.description: How the fact was detected. gh-description + manual-reasoning + existing-doc CANNOT support confidence=confirmed for a code relationship (plan: never assert relationships from documentation alone).

confidence.description: confirmed = grounded in code/config/git via a code-level detection_method. strong-inference = supported but derived (e.g. from a gh description or a single doc). unknown = flagged for follow-up.

last_verified.description: ISO date the fact was last checked.
